Uses of Package
org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema

Packages that use org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema
Package
Description
org.aristonis.diwan.database.android
Android support: a driver over Android's own SQLiteDatabase, for Android 9 (API 28) and later, where JDBC is not available.
org.aristonis.diwan.database.manager
Builds named connections from configuration the first time they are used and hands out the query, schema and migrator objects of each.
org.aristonis.diwan.database.migrations
Migrations: schema changes written as classes, and the table that records which ones ran.
org.aristonis.diwan.database.pgsql
PostgreSQL support: the schema grammar that turns a blueprint into PostgreSQL SQL, the query grammar and processor, and a migration lock built on advisory locks.
org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema
Schema building: describe tables with a Blueprint and run them through a Schema.
org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema.grammar
 
org.aristonis.diwan.database.seeding
Runs seeders: classes that fill a database with starting data.
org.aristonis.diwan.database.sqlite
SQLite support: the schema grammar that turns a blueprint into SQLite SQL, and the query grammar and processor that run the query builder on SQLite.
org.aristonis.diwan.database.testing
Test support: a JUnit 5 extension that gives every test a clean database, and assertions on database rows and models.
